programs.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programs.desc: Rick tries out a new recipe - pork chops with a sloe berry sauce, before heading to the village of Rock, where his son, Jack, holds a clam bake on the shore of the Camel Estuary.

programs.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programs.desc: The town of Launceston is bypassed by many who visit Cornwall, yet Rick discovers it's home to an unusual superstition. Rick rounds off his trip cooking an alfresco dish of Cornish mussels with cider.

programs.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programs.desc: In Rio de Janeiro, Anthony learns how to be a Carioca and cook like one too. Feijoada, Brazil's national dish, is also featured.

programs.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programs.desc: Everyone knows Tony likes to drink, especially after a hard night at Les Halles. In this episode, Tony tries to discover what exactly make the perfect watering hole in New York. Some of his requirements include a loaded juke box, an absence of karaoke, and a bartender who leans towards crazy.

programs.title: Getting Grilled With Curtis Stone
programs.desc: Teri Hatcher is in the hot seat, and she is not afraid of the fire! The actress proves she's an open book, spilling stories and details you haven't heard before about her childhood.

programs.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programs.desc: Chef Asma Khan makes spiced Kabab Burgers, crispy monsoon pakoras, flavourful koftas and indulgent chilli cheese toasties - perfect sumptuous snacks.
